title: Demo Tenant Reset Checklist (Standard Demo v1)
linked_artifacts: Linear: ENG-4922 (Create demo dashboards + saved views)
content:
Purpose
- Keep the Standard Demo v1 tenant reliable, predictable, and safe for live prospect calls.
- This checklist is intentionally “boring”: do the same steps every time.

Owner / escalation (business hours)
- Primary driver (SE on call): rotate per region (see Confluence dashboards & alerts doc)
- Platform/SRE escalation: Rafael Mendes / Sean Gallagher
- If you find a repeatable break: file a ticket + paste repro steps in #sales + #eng-sre

What you need open before you start
- Redwood Console (demo tenant): https://console.redwoodinference.internal/tenants/demo-standard-v1
- Demo dashboards (saved views): Overview, Latency, Cost/Token, Errors, Routing/Fallback, Quotas
- Local scripts/quickstart (or “Known Good Matrix” row links)

Guardrails (do NOT skip)
- Never paste customer data (or anything that could be sensitive) into the demo tenant.
- Confirm you are in the demo tenant (not prod / not a prospect tenant).
- Do not change pinned model versions or routing rules live on a call unless you are executing the Backup Plan steps below.

PRE-DEMO CHECKLIST

T-60 min (recommended for first demo of the day / after any incident)
[ ] 1) Confirm tenant + region
    - Console header shows: Tenant = demo-standard-v1
    - If EMEA data residency is required: plan to narrate EU-only routing; do not claim EU-only processing if the route is not pinned to EU.

[ ] 2) Confirm model/version pinning is correct
    - Routes > “standard-chat” uses pinned model version (no “latest”).
    - Quantization profile matches the scenario (per talk track).
    - Routing/fallback route has an explicit fallback target and health criteria enabled.

[ ] 3) Reset quotas + rate limits to demo defaults
    - Quotas page: set to “Demo Default” preset (avoid surprise 429s).
    - Verify remaining quota is high enough for streaming + tool calling scenario.
    - Confirm burst limits are enabled (demo-safe) and that any manual throttles are removed.
    Notes: If you see recent 429s in the last 24h, do a full reset and run the smoke tests below.

[ ] 4) Reset seed data + artifacts
    - Run reset script (idempotent): demo-tenant-reset --tenant demo-standard-v1 --full
    - Verify seeded prompt sets and saved eval run(s) exist (no customer content).
    - Verify the “Known Good” saved requests are present in Console (if applicable).

[ ] 5) Clear/verify any “live-edit” risk
    - Rollouts: ensure no active canary/experiment is running unless part of the demo.
    - Disable any temporary routes created for debugging.
    - Confirm dashboard filters are set to tenant-wide, not your user-only view.

T-15 min (always do this right before the call)
[ ] 6) Dashboard sanity check (last 30–60 min window)
    - Overview: traffic low/normal, no error spikes
    - Latency: p50/p95 within expected band for demo (don’t quote exact numbers; confirm it’s “healthy”)
    - Cost/Token: panels load (no missing queries)
    - Errors: 5xx not elevated, no gateway timeouts
    - Quotas: no unusual throttling

[ ] 7) Run “smoke test” requests (2 minutes total)
    - A) Basic chat completion (non-streaming)
    - B) Streaming chat (confirm tokens stream continuously for ~10–15 seconds)
    - C) Tool/function calling (confirm structured tool payload returns)
    - D) Fallback trigger test (only if planned for the call): force primary unhealthy in the test route OR use the built-in “simulate failure” toggle if available
    - Record: if any step fails, do NOT improvise. Use Backup Plan.

[ ] 8) Prep the call assets
    - Have deck open to: Routing/Fallback + Observability sections
    - Have a copy/paste buffer ready for prompts (avoid typing errors)
    - Have screenshots ready (Console clickpaths) in case the UI lags

DURING-DEMO MINI-CHECKS (quick, non-disruptive)
[ ] Keep the dashboard Overview tab open on a second screen to catch 429/5xx quickly.
[ ] If latency spikes mid-call, pause and narrate what you’re checking (don’t keep retrying the same request).
[ ] If a response varies (nondeterminism): narrate that outputs can vary; then switch to the expected-output version of the scenario (canned output or screenshot) instead of re-rolling live.

BACKUP PLAN (if anything flakes live)

Trigger conditions
- Streaming disconnects, repeated 429s, unexpected 5xx, Console panels not loading, or primary model health not stable.

Actions (do in order)
[ ] 1) Stop the live request loop
    - Say: “Let me switch to a deterministic view so we don’t waste your time.”

[ ] 2) Switch to ‘Demo-Safe’ route / profile
    - Use the preconfigured “standard-chat-demo-safe” route (lower variance, more conservative timeouts)
    - Re-run only the simplest request (non-streaming) to re-establish confidence.

[ ] 3) Pivot the narrative (choose one)
    - If latency is the issue: show Cost/Token + batching/caching controls (screenshots acceptable)
    - If routing/fallback is the issue: show the routing policy config and the intended behavior; use the recorded output
    - If Console is slow: use deck screenshots + describe API first, then return to Console later

[ ] 4) If the tenant is clearly unhealthy
    - Announce: “Our demo environment is degraded; we’ll follow up with the full live run on a fresh tenant.”
    - Switch to: 2-minute Hosted API mini-demo (curl-only) OR pre-recorded run.
    - Immediately message #eng-sre + #sales with timestamp + dashboard link.

POST-DEMO CHECKLIST (same day)

T+15 min after the call
[ ] 1) Reset any temporary changes you made
    - Revert any modified routes, timeouts, or model selections
    - Ensure experiments/canaries are stopped

[ ] 2) Confirm tenant is clean
    - Delete any ad-hoc prompt content created during the call (if stored)
    - Confirm no customer identifiers were pasted into saved objects (if yes, escalate to Security immediately)

[ ] 3) Quick health check
    - Errors dashboard: confirm no ongoing 5xx spike
    - Quotas: ensure remaining quota is not near empty for the next demo

[ ] 4) Log learnings (2 minutes)
    - Add a note to the running “Demo Day Dry Runs / Field Feedback” doc if something was confusing or broke.
    - If there was a visible failure: create a ticket with:
      - What scenario
      - Exact timestamp + region
      - Console URL(s) and request IDs
      - Whether Backup Plan was used

WEEKLY / BEFORE BIG EXEC DEMOS
[ ] Run full “Known Good Matrix” regression suite (or latest automated check) and confirm all scenarios are green.
[ ] Confirm dashboard imports have not drifted (no missing panels).
[ ] Confirm pinned model versions align with the talk track (no silent upgrades).

Common failure symptoms → likely cause → what to do
- 429 throttling: quotas not reset / burst disabled → apply Demo Default preset + re-smoke-test
- Streaming drops: network / gateway timeout / client issue → switch to non-streaming + use recorded streaming output
- Missing dashboard panels: import drift or query permission changes → use saved screenshot + file ticket (see dashboard doc)
- Fallback didn’t trigger: route policy changed or health check disabled → do not live-edit; switch to screenshot + follow up with full live run later

Revision notes
- v1.2 (2025-03-04): added explicit T-15 smoke test set + clarified Backup Plan wording; aligned quotas language with support learnings from 429 confusion.
- If you propose changes to this checklist: tag Renee Sullivan + Markus Klein and include the reason (what broke / what we’re preventing).
